name: morph-context-compiler
description: A lossless representation compiler for model-facing structured context.

scripts.test:extended: cross-env MORPH_PROPERTY_RUNS=5000 vitest run tests/property tests/integration tests/security
scripts.verify:pr: pnpm check:repo && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.verify:cli: pnpm morph doctor && pnpm morph compare --input fixtures/examples/customers.json --task-file fixtures/examples/lookup.task.txt --target local-o200k-base --policy economy-experimental && pnpm morph compile --input fixtures/examples/customers.json --task-file fixtures/examples/lookup.task.txt --target local-o200k-base --policy compatibility --output artifacts/ci-smoke.morph.json --force && pnpm morph render --input artifacts/ci-smoke.morph.json --output artifacts/ci-smoke.context.txt --force && pnpm morph decode --input artifacts/ci-smoke.morph.json --output artifacts/ci-smoke.restored.json --force && pnpm morph verify --input artifacts/ci-smoke.morph.json
scripts.verify:ci: pnpm verify:pr && pnpm smoke:package && pnpm verify:cli && pnpm morph bench --suite conformance --offline
scripts.verify:release: pnpm verify:ci && pnpm test:extended && pnpm bench:tokens && pnpm bench:performance
